entries.1a5ad403af7e25fc: This business is run by the subsidiary Mr Max Co., Ltd., which sells household electrical appliances, daily necessities, apparel, food and other products on a self-service basis. Total store sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥142,134 million, and the number of stores as of fiscal year-end was 59.
entries.2835c8685911cbba: This division handles household electrical appliances. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥20,225 million. It also handles private-brand products, which sell appliance manufacturers' products as models exclusive to the company.
entries.3104cc0460305462: The subsidiary Logidia Co., Ltd. conducts the 3PL business for the group's supply chain. The amount for this business is not separately disclosed.
entries.3579f7ae77651811: This division handles lifestyle-related products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥18,797 million.
entries.61737e91596b4d75: This division handles housing-related products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥12,504 million.
entries.62317b3cdad2b162: This is a department handling foods, such as rice and processed foods. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥56,386 million, the largest of the departments.
entries.63b4896de0c4f3aa: This division handles clothing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,897 million.
entries.77511ed0e480d264: This is a department handling daily necessities and cosmetics, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥27,714 million.
entries.a81dd267e6ce71be: A holding company that operates 59 "MrMax" general discount stores, centered on Kyushu, selling food, home appliances, daily necessities and other goods at everyday low prices.
entries.cae3a8e63438a3f2: This is a business conducted by the company together with management of group companies. Of the 59 stores in Japan, 25 are operated and managed as shopping centers. The amount for this business is not separately disclosed.
